summary: Frontend-only test of 3 new features on the V3 funnel: A/B test wrapper on `/`, Zodiac interlude on /experience, and Home unification (starfield backdrop + Cormorant italic accent) — plus non-regression checks. Executed 14 targeted Playwright checks against the preview URL. ALL 14 CHECKS PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: ABTestHome: override logic correctly bypasses the flag OFF gate (line 46). Analytics event only fires when flag enabled — acceptable.

ZodiacInterlude: overlay z-index 900 works but is inline-styled rather than themed via CSS vars — consider extraction if reused. Auto-continue 5.2s timer is not cancelled if user clicks continue; harmless because onComplete idempotent-ish, but two-fire possible.
StarfieldBackdrop: correctly pointer-events:none and honours prefers-reduced-motion. Good.
computeZodiac: uses UTC month/day which may off-by-one for dates in local TZ near midnight. Acceptable for MVP but note it if precision matters.
test_credentials: test@plume-astrale.fr / TestPlume2026! (used for /mon-accueil auth). Login redirected to /mon-compte then /mon-accueil reachable.
seed_data_creation: sessionStorage set manually for welcome zodiac test: exp_intent=self_discovery, exp_zodiac=vierge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_83 verified: (1) A/B off default → homepage; ?ab=exp force redirect works even with flag off; ?ab=home forces homepage. (2) Zodiac interlude appears after scene-2-choice-clarity, submit disabled when empty, 1990-09-15 reveals 'Vierge' + 'TERRE', sessionStorage exp_zodiac='vierge', continue closes and scrolls to scene-3-cards. Skip closes without setting sessionStorage. (3) Starfield-backdrop child of nocturne-hero, pointer-events:none, CTA to /inscription clickable. Title accent span 'un livre.' rendered with Cormorant Garamond italic. Non-regressions OK: /experience?utm_campaign=vierge shows experience-zodiac-shortcut; /inscription form loads; /mon-accueil without ?welcome=1 shows no splash; with ?welcome=1 shows welcome-zodiac with 'SIGNE VIERGE' + welcome-title.
